conversion_event: paid tool call via the Voidnet marketplace (Voidnet meters and bills; our proxy step is 'activate' = a tools/call that reached the tools)
notes: The Voidnet listing is Free Only: the public, login-free API https://www.openvoidnet.com/api/marketplace/apps/tariffmonitor reports has_paid_tier=false and stripe_price_id=null (checked 2026-10-11). So a PAID call cannot happen until Dale sets a paid tier, which needs his console login and Stripe Connect. See growth/drafts/voidnet-paid-calls.md.

Health checks: src/funnel.js checkArrivals(), daily via setInterval inside the tariffmonitor-mcp pm2 process on VM100; results in data/funnel.db arrival_checks. Failures mail Dale through AdCreator's opsAlert and set the arrival to paused.
The /mcp endpoint is key-gated by design: an unauthenticated POST must return 401. A 200 there would be the failure.
The listing page HTML is client-rendered (it shows no app text), so the health check reads the public JSON API for the listing's content.
